success.description: Azyr magic flows from your outstretched hand and through the eyes of the target, entering their mind. Until the end of the encounter, the target acquires the Education skill (and the ability to read and write) if they did not have it acquired and gains 1 rank of training in Education if they did have it acquired
As above, and the target also gains the ability to understand and speak 1 language that they did not know before until the end of the encounter
